51584210.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to recombinant NSD3 (1021 to 1322 residues) (unknown origin) expressed in Escherichia coli Rossetta (DE3) assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - 4.4. Surface pla: The binding kinetics was measured by SPR (Biacore 8k+, Cytiva). NSD3-SET was immobilized to a CM5 sensor chip via amine groups in 10 mM sodium acetate buffer (pH 5.0) for a final RU around 16000. The running buffer was composed of 10 mM PBS (pH 7.4), 2% DMSO, and 0.05% Tween-20. For kinetics analysis, the concentrations of compounds ranging from 3.125 μM to 50 μM flowed over the chip at a flow rate of 30 μl/min for 60 s followed by a 60 s dissociation step. The resulting data were fitted to a 1:1 binding model using Biacore Insight Evaluation software (Cytiva).
original_paragraph.Results - 2.4. Compound 3 directly binds: Based on the inhibitory potency against NSD2 and NSD3, compound 3 was selected to be examined the binding affinity to the NSD3-SET protein. Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) was performed to determine the direct interaction. As a result, compound 3 bound to the NSD3-SET domain with a K_d of 4.87 μM in SPR whereas SAM, as a positive control, with a K_d of 25 μM (Table 3 and Supplementary Fig. S1).
